h1: Funnel care: a first sprint on pages, forms and follow-ups
overview: Funnels wear out. Links break, offers go stale and a form stops sending alerts without anyone noticing. We start with a care sprint in your own accounts: we test every step as a visitor, fix what is broken, update offers and wording, and check the follow-up emails still send. You get a log of what we changed and a list of what to watch. Monthly care after the sprint is quoted separately.

faq: No. This is a fixed starter sprint. If you want us to keep going every month, ask for a written quote for monthly care, and we agree a regular price and scope.
What counts as a content update?
A change to text, an image, a button, an offer or a form field on an existing page. Building a new page is bigger, and we quote it separately or you can order a landing page.
Can you work on the funnel if someone else built it?
Yes. We review what exists, make safe changes and note anything unusual. We confirm the scope in writing and avoid changing things we cannot test.
Staff or collaborator access to your site, form tool, email tool and analytics. We never need passwords, and you can remove our access at the end of the sprint.
